Rózsai, M., Jaxa-Rozen, M., Salvucci, R., Sikora, P., Gea Bermudez, J. and Neuwahl, F. (2026). JRC-IDEES-2023: the Integrated Database of the European Energy System - Data update and technical documentation. European Commission, Joint Research Centre, JRC144707 (EUR 40600). With the JRC-IDEES-2023 EU27 data files (JRC-IDEES-2023_EU27.zip, release 2025-11-06).

Region: EU27, year 2023. JRC-IDEES is a calibrated top-down decomposition of Eurostat energy balances into subsector, process and fuel (not plant data). Loaded only where one technology serves all of a subsector physical output: EAF arc furnace electricity per t EAF steel, primary aluminium electrolysis electricity per t, and the cement kiln line (pre-heating/pre-calcination plus kilns) fuel per t cement, with 2023 capacity utilisation. In _other-values: subsector and step intensities for BF-BOF, EAF, alumina, primary and secondary aluminium, cement, glass, pulp and paper (2023, with 2021-edition values for comparison), capacity utilisation and outputs. Not loaded: chemicals, ceramics and printing (outputs in ethylene, brick or paper equivalents), non-energy-intensive sectors (output index), thermal-vs-electric step splits (no output split), useful-energy ratios (a modelled service quantity, not equipment efficiency), emissions, and the residential, tertiary, transport, power and balance files of the zip. The ISI_fec process rows count blast-furnace coke and derived gases as final energy; coke ovens sit outside the industry file. Conversion 41.868 GJ/toe. Locator: sheet and row code (the files carry a unique code per row).
